slides.title: ARK STUDIOS — Board Security Briefing
slides.notes: Welcome. This is a 10-minute review of where our security stands and the few decisions we need from you.
Lead with reassurance: our biggest risks were caught before production. Then the honest picture of what's still open.
The headline numbers. Emphasise that critical issues are resolved or verified.
Show the board how a reentrancy attack works in plain terms — the ATM analogy — and that we caught it before mainnet. This is the most powerful slide for a non-technical audience.
Phishing: 15% of staff fell for it. Use this to justify the passkey rollout budget.
We fix what we find. Show the remediation rate and MTTR.
The three asks: finish segmentation, complete MFA rollout, fund the Q2 pentest.
Questions. Decisions needed: budget approval for passkeys and segmentation change window.
